ads.alt: Photo of a man's bare shoulder with a copper-toned LESPIRANT L-Cut undershirt worn open at the front. Text reads: No Sweat Stains. No Collar. Invisible, even under a thin white shirt. I want my L-Cut.
Close-up photo of the TENCEL fabric swing tag pinned to a copper L-Cut undershirt. Text reads: TENCEL Fabric. Softer Than Cotton. Sweat-wicking, odor-resistant, 100% Made in EU. I want my L-Cut.
Three flat-lay product photos of the L-Cut undershirt in its Nude, Copper, and Maroon colorways side by side. Text reads: 3 Skin Tones. Always Invisible. Nude, Copper, Maroon. I want my L-Cut.
Photo of seamstresses sewing garments in LESPIRANT's EU workshop. Text reads: 100% Made in EU. Living wages, health insurance, fair trade. Sustainability.
